Who this is for

Long Island is home to about 112,000 South Asian residents, about seven in ten of them in Nassau County. Hicksville alone has about 8,700, roughly one in five people in town. The guide covers Indian, Pakistani, Bangladeshi, Sri Lankan, Nepali and Indo-Caribbean families, and everyone who loves a good festival.

Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020–2024 5-year estimates, via censusreporter.org.
